products.product_title: Bosch BCH6ATH25 Athlet 25.2 V Cordless Stick Vacuum Cleaner, White
products.ebay_title: Bosch BCH6ATH25 Athlet Cordless Vacuum Cleaner 25.2V Stick Upright White
products.short_description:
Cordless 25.2 V stick vacuum with a motorised floor brush.

  • AllFloor HighPower Brush for carpet and hard floors
  • SmartSensor Control adjusts power to the surface
  • Freestanding for storage and charging
products.long_description:
Overview

The Athlet BCH6ATH25 is a cordless upright vacuum built on Bosch's 25.2 V battery system. Cleaning power is rated as equivalent to a 2400 W corded machine, which is the comparison Bosch draws when placing it against a mains cylinder vacuum.

Floor brush

A single motorised AllFloor HighPower Brush covers carpet and hard floors without swapping heads, and it is fed by an air guide system designed around that brush rather than adapted from a corded model. SmartSensor Control varies the power itself instead of leaving it to the operator.

Storage

The machine stands upright on its own, so it can be parked and charged where it stands rather than needing a wall fixing.

products.ebay_title: Bosch MFW67440 Meat Mincer Grinder 700W Sausage Kebbe Shredder Discs Black
products.short_description:
Corded meat mincer with sausage, kebbe and shredding attachments.

  • 700 W rated power, 2000 W motor block
  • Perforated discs in 3, 4.8 and 8 mm
  • Reverse function to clear jams
products.long_description:
Overview

The MFW67440 is a mains-powered mincer for meat and fish, sized for regular batch work rather than occasional use. A filling tray and pusher feed the worm, and the reverse function backs the worm out when sinew or bone fragments jam the head instead of forcing a strip-down mid-batch.

Mincing

Three perforated discs cover coarse through to fine, so the same machine handles burger mince and a finer sausage fill. The discs and cutting parts come apart for cleaning.

Beyond mincing

A sausage attachment and a filling aid let the minced meat go straight into casings, and a kebbe attachment forms the hollow tubes used for that dish. A continuous shredder unit with interchangeable barrels takes on vegetables and cheese, so the mincer covers grating and slicing as well.

  • 3 perforated discs (3 mm, 4.8 mm, 8 mm)
  • Sausage attachment
  • Kebbe attachment
  • Continuous shredder with coarse shredding barrel and slicing barrel
  • Filling aid
  • Filling tray
  • Pusher

products.product_title: Bosch TWK8613P Styline Kettle 1.5 L 2400 W, Temperature Control, Black
products.ebay_title: Bosch TWK8613P Styline Kettle 1.5L 2400W Temperature Control Keep Warm Black
products.short_description:
Cordless 1.5 L kettle with four temperature settings and keep warm.

  • 2400 W with 1.5 litre capacity
  • Four temperatures: 70, 80, 90 °C and boiling
  • Keep warm holds the set temperature for 30 minutes
products.long_description:
Overview

A 1.5 litre cordless kettle from the Bosch Styline range, finished in black with stainless steel detailing. The 360° base allows the kettle to be lifted and replaced from any angle, and cable length is adjustable at the base. Lift-switch-off cuts the power when the kettle is removed.

Temperature control

Four settings cover 70 °C, 80 °C, 90 °C and boiling, so water can be brought to the temperature a green tea, an infusion or instant coffee actually needs. The keep warm function then holds the selected temperature for up to 30 minutes.

Construction and cleaning

The housing is double-walled, which keeps the contents hot and reduces the temperature of the outer surface. The heating element and heating tray are covered in stainless steel, so there is no exposed element in the water. The lid opens at the touch of a button and the limescale filter lifts out for rinsing.

products.ebay_title: Pioneer TS-A6991F 6x9 5 Way Coaxial Car Speakers 700W 120W RMS 4 Ohm
products.short_description:
Five-way 6 x 9 inch coaxial car speakers rated 700 W maximum.

  • 700 W maximum, 120 W nominal input power
  • 29 Hz to 33 kHz response, 92 dB sensitivity
  • Carbon and mica reinforced IMPP composite cone
products.long_description:
Overview

The TS-A6991F is the five-way model in Pioneer's A-Series, built for the oval 6 x 9 inch apertures found in the rear parcel shelf and doors of many vehicles.

Design

The mid-bass cone is an injection moulded polypropylene composite reinforced with carbon and mica, which raises stiffness without a weight penalty. Ferrite magnets are used throughout, and Pioneer's Open & Smooth treatment is applied to the transition from mid-bass to tweeter so the handover is not audible as a step in the response.

Fitting

Speaker grilles are supplied. This is a deeper chassis than a two-way speaker of the same diameter, so check the clearance behind the mounting surface before ordering.

Overview

The TS-D69F sits in Pioneer's D-Series and is built for the oval 6 x 9 inch apertures used in the rear parcel shelf and doors of many vehicles, so it can go in as a direct replacement for a factory-fitted speaker.

Design

The mid-bass driver runs an aramid fibre interlaced IMPP composite cone on a ferrite magnet, chosen to stay rigid under load without adding mass. The Win Wing 2 Road is a strap-mounted rear mudguard for road bikes, made in Sweden. The Standard Edition is the complete guard with the wishbone holder and straps, as opposed to the blade-only replacement.

Mounting is tool-free using the TPU straps, with three angle settings to suit different seat stay geometries and a recommended 5 to 10 mm clearance from the tyre. The strap carries a slot for a zip tie if the guard is left on the bike unattended. It clears tyres up to 35 mm.

An electric lice comb that clears head lice and nits by combing combined with an electrical impulse, with no shampoo or chemical treatment involved.

While switched on the comb emits a continuous acoustic signal. The signal changes when the teeth meet a louse or nit, and an impulse is released that kills the parasite. The impulse is harmless to and imperceptible by the person being combed.

The comb is used on dry hair, held at roughly 45 degrees to the scalp and drawn slowly from the roots to the tips. The teeth are cleared with the supplied brush between passes.

Overview

The WL 32 is a bedside clock that brings the light up gradually ahead of the alarm time instead of waking the room in one step. Two alarm times can be stored, which covers a household on two different schedules or a weekday and weekend setting.

Light functions

Beyond the wake-up simulation, the lamp doubles as a night light and as a mood light with a colour-change cycle or a fixed colour. Brightness is adjustable across a range of levels, and the clock display has a colour backlight.

Radio and sound

The FM radio holds ten preset stations and can be used as the wake-up sound, as the alarm tone alternative, or on the good-night timer that plays for a set period and then shuts off. An AUX input takes an external audio source. The clock runs from the mains adapter; battery operation keeps the clock and settings going through a power cut, though the light function needs mains power.

products.short_description:

products.long_description:
Overview

The AM307 is a LoRaWAN indoor ambience monitoring sensor that reports seven parameters from a single wall-mounted housing: temperature, humidity, carbon dioxide, TVOC, barometric pressure, light level and PIR occupancy.

Readings on the device

A 4.2-inch black and white E-Ink screen shows the current readings without a gateway or app, with selectable layouts, emoticon and traffic-light indicators and a built-in buzzer for alarms.

Power and installation

The sensor runs from four replaceable ER14505 Li-SOCl2 batteries or from a 5V/1A USB Type-C supply, and mounts to a wall with adhesive tape or screws.

Network

Communication is LoRaWAN Class A with OTAA or ABP activation over an internal antenna. This part number is supplied for the EU868 band.

products.product_title: Milesight EM300-SLD-868M LoRaWAN Spot Leakage Detection Sensor
products.ebay_title: Milesight EM300-SLD-868M LoRaWAN Spot Leak Detection Sensor EU868 IP67
products.short_description:
LoRaWAN spot leak sensor with a probe, plus temperature and humidity.

  • Two-pin probe on a 1.5 m cable detects conducting liquid
  • IP67 UV-resistant enclosure
  • Replaceable 4000 mAh Li-SOCl2 battery
products.long_description:
Overview

The EM300-SLD is a LoRaWAN sensor for spot leak detection. A cabled two-pin probe is placed at the point where water is likely to collect, and the sensor reports an alarm when conducting liquid bridges the pins. Temperature and humidity are measured by the sensor body at the same time.

Installation

The IP67 UV-resistant enclosure suits plant rooms, basements and other wet or unheated locations. The probe sits on a 1.5 m cable so the electronics can be mounted clear of the floor.

Power and data

Power comes from a single replaceable 4000 mAh ER18505 Li-SOCl2 battery, with an 8000 mAh option. Up to 2,800 records are held locally and can be retransmitted after a gap in coverage. Milesight D2D lets the sensor trigger another Milesight device directly, without waiting for the network server.

  • 2 x 4-20 mA, 2 x 0-10 V and 2 x PT100 inputs
  • RS485 with Modbus RTU, plus RS232
products.long_description:
Overview

The UC300 is a LoRaWAN controller that brings wired field devices onto a LoRaWAN network. It combines digital, analogue, RTD and serial interfaces in a DIN-rail sized metal housing.

Inputs and outputs

Four opto-isolated digital inputs accept 3-24 VDC and work as either state inputs or pulse counters up to 4000 Hz. Two SPDT relay outputs switch up to 3 A. Analogue measurement covers two 4-20 mA and two 0-10 V channels at 12-bit resolution, with two PT100 RTD inputs in 2-wire or 3-wire configuration.

Serial and logic

An RS485 port speaks Modbus RTU or passes data transparently, and an RS232 port operates in transparent mode, both from 1200 to 115200 bps. Threshold alarms, IF-THEN commands, local data storage and retransmission run on the device itself.

Power and mounting

Supply is 5-24 VDC through the terminal block, with surge and reverse polarity protection, or 5 V over USB Type-C. The unit mounts on a desk, a wall or a DIN rail.

products.ebay_title: De'Longhi DNS80 Tasciugo AriaDry Light Zeolite Dehumidifier 7.5L Ionizer Grey
products.short_description:
Compressor-free zeolite dehumidifier with ioniser, 7.5 litres a day.

  • Zeolite adsorption, no compressor
  • Up to 7.5 litres removed per 24 hours
  • Ioniser, timer and laundry drying programme
products.long_description:
Overview

An adsorption dehumidifier that uses a zeolite rotor rather than a compressor. It keeps working at low room temperatures and runs without the noise of a compressor cycling, which suits bedrooms, small flats and unheated rooms.

How it works

Moist air is drawn across a zeolite wheel that holds the water vapour. A heater then drives the moisture back out of the wheel and it condenses into the tank. There is no refrigerant circuit, which keeps the unit light enough to carry between rooms, and a drain hose is supplied for continuous running.

Air treatment and control

An ioniser can be switched on to treat the air as it circulates. Target humidity is set between 45 and 65 per cent, a laundry programme runs the unit for drying washing indoors, and the timer lets it run for a set period and shut off.

products.product_title: Dragino LHT65N-868 LoRaWAN Temperature and Humidity Sensor, EU868
products.ebay_title: Dragino LHT65N-868 LoRaWAN Temperature Humidity Sensor EU868 Class A 2400mAh
products.short_description:
LoRaWAN Class A temperature and humidity sensor, 2400 mAh battery.

  • Measures -40 to 80 °C and 0-96% RH
  • 2400 mAh battery, up to 10 years of service
  • Optional external probe to 125 °C
products.long_description:
Overview

A battery-powered LoRaWAN node that reports temperature and humidity from a built-in sensor and, where one is fitted, from an external probe. It joins the network as a Class A device, so the radio wakes only to transmit and briefly listen, which is what allows the battery to last for years.

Sensing

The internal sensor covers ordinary indoor conditions and cold storage. The external E3 probe extends the measurement range well past what the housing itself would tolerate, which suits freezers, pipework and plant rooms.

Deployment

Reporting interval and other parameters are changed remotely by LoRaWAN downlink, so nodes do not have to be collected once installed. If the gateway is unreachable the node keeps logging, and the stored records are sent once coverage returns. A tri-colour LED shows join and transmit status during commissioning.

products.ebay_title: Dragino LT-22222-L-868 LoRaWAN IO Controller 2 Relay 2 DI 2 DO 0-20mA 0-30V
products.short_description:
LoRaWAN I/O controller with two relays and analogue inputs.

  • 2 relay outputs rated 5 A at 250 V AC / 30 V DC
  • 2 digital inputs and 2 digital outputs
  • 2 x 0-20 mA and 2 x 0-30 V analogue inputs
products.long_description:
Overview

A LoRaWAN I/O controller for remote monitoring and switching. It reads contacts and analogue signals from field equipment and drives relay and digital outputs, reporting over a long-range low-power radio link instead of a wired run back to a controller.

Inputs and outputs

The digital inputs are bi-directional, so either polarity of contact is accepted. The analogue inputs cover both the industrial current loop and a wide DC voltage range, which suits transmitters, level sensors and battery monitoring. The relay outputs are rated for mains switching, and the unit is powered from a DC supply within its input range.

Network

The controller runs as a Class A device to conserve power, or as Class C, keeping the receiver open so downlink commands act on the outputs without waiting for the next uplink.

products.product_title: Shadow SHRBPRO Rockabilly Pro Dual Pickup and Preamp for Double Bass
products.ebay_title: Shadow SHRBPRO Rockabilly Pro Dual Pickup Preamp Double Bass Tuner 9V
products.short_description:
Dual pickup and preamp system for upright bass with built-in tuner.

  • Bridge pickup plus under-fingerboard slap pickup
  • Separate EQ for the bridge and slap channels
  • Automatic chromatic tuner and phase switch
products.long_description:
Overview

The Rockabilly Pro is an active pickup and preamp system for upright bass and tololoche. It splits the instrument's two voices — the bowed or plucked note and the percussive slap — into separate channels so each can be shaped independently rather than fighting for the same EQ.

Pickups

A bridge pickup captures the string signal and a dedicated slap pickup mounts beneath the fingerboard to pick up the percussive attack. The system can be run as a mono blend into one amplifier, or as a two-channel output so the pickups feed separate channels or a mixer.

Preamp and controls

The bridge channel carries gain, bass, mid, presence and volume controls plus a subsonic filter and pre-shape switch. The slap channel has gain, low-cut, treble, volume and a selectable frequency control. A phase switch helps deal with phase cancellation between the two pickups, and an automatic chromatic tuner is built in for tuning on stage. The preamp runs from a 9 V battery.

products.product_title: Milesight UG65-L04EU-868M-EA LoRaWAN Gateway, Cellular and Ethernet
products.ebay_title: Milesight UG65-L04EU-868M-EA LoRaWAN Gateway EU868 Cellular Ethernet PoE
products.short_description:
Semi-industrial 8-channel LoRaWAN gateway, cellular and Ethernet.

  • 8 half or full-duplex channels on EU868
  • Cellular backhaul with mini SIM slot
  • Gigabit Ethernet with 802.3af PoE and 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi
products.long_description:
Overview

The UG65 is a semi-industrial LoRaWAN gateway for buildings, campuses and light industrial sites. This build covers the EU868 band, takes an external antenna and carries both Ethernet and cellular backhaul.

Radio and capacity

Eight half or full-duplex channels handle LoRaWAN V1.0 and V1.0.2 Class A, B and C devices, around 2,000 of them at ten-minute uplink intervals. Receive sensitivity is -140 dBm at 292 bps with transmit power to 27 dBm, and the 50 Ω N-Female connector accepts an external antenna for placement away from the housing.

Backhaul and network server

Data leaves over a gigabit RJ45 port with 802.3af PoE input, over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, or over the cellular module using the mini SIM slot. An embedded network server with multicast and FUOTA runs on the gateway, and integrations cover MQTT(S), HTTP(S), BACnet/IP and Modbus TCP. It can also run as a packet forwarder to The Things Stack or ChirpStack, with Python SDK and Node-RED available for local logic.

Build

The IP65 PC and ABS enclosure is rated from -40°C to 70°C and mounts on a desk, a wall or a pole.

products.long_description:
Overview

A 65-inch 4K set using a QD-Mini LED backlight with local dimming, aimed at higher contrast than a conventional edge-lit LED panel.

Picture

Mini LED zones dim independently behind the quantum dot layer, and the set accepts Dolby Vision and HDR10 material. The 120 Hz panel handles fast motion and higher frame rate console output.

Sound and connections

Dolby Atmos decoding drives the built-in speakers. Three HDMI 2.1 inputs cover current consoles and sources, alongside two USB ports, Wi-Fi and terrestrial, cable and satellite tuners. Google TV supplies the app platform and Google Assistant voice control.
